# Inspection Preparation Functions

Domain specialization of ordinary document preparation for an inspection. `domainPrepare` requires an `inspector` party, a nonempty text `inspectionTerms.scopeId`, and `inspectionTerms.standard` equal to `approved-scope-review`. It freezes those inspection terms; `domainValidateCandidate` rejects changed terms.

For a usable selected document, `domainNextActions` describes an inspector action until `result.status` is `recorded`, then returns no next actions. This description grants no authority and does not itself record an inspection. Preparation freezes a requirement before creation or provision. Provision requires the expected supplier, request correlation, requirement reference and initialized document origin. Normalized source, effective policy, every party role and identity, allowed value slots and approval requirements must match. An extra undeclared party is rejected even when the child acquired it through its own admission; a stored witness cannot authorize an expanded roster. An unrelated old field alone is not a rejection rule.

Selection is distinct from usability. General admission can seek authorized approval, the incoming participant's consent and access before linking. A selected child becomes usable only when its Activation is active and its source and reader requirements are ready. Identity substitution is rejected; matching retries do not create a second obligation.
